subject: Feasibility checkpoints: private hosting resource delta & architecture options
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-25T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Quick feasibility check for Acme Health (private pilot)

Irene / Karthik —

Acme Health (prospect) asked for a tight feasibility note to feed Procurement today. They want: a short pilot (6 weeks) on their VPC with on-prem gateway for PHI workloads, SOC 2 evidence, and a minimal SLA for latency. Procurement deadline is EOD Friday. Can you help with: 

- One-paragraph summary of architecture feasibility (network, kms, connectivity patterns)
- Minimum staffing required from infra/ops for pilot (oncall, SRE, infra eng)
- Known blockers or exceptions (e.g., airgap constraints, HSM needed, audit logging gaps)

I attached the pilot-scope-delta.xlsx with customer asks. If we can turn this around in a day-ish I'll drop it in HubSpot. Appreciate a terse statement we can hand to Sales.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-25T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick feasibility check for Acme Health (private pilot)

Evelyn —

High level (short answer for Procurement): feasible with constraints. Bullet version for HubSpot / procurement: 

- Architecture: supported. We can run model serving in customer VPC via our Private control plane with a customer-hosted reverse proxy and a per-tenant gateway. KV caching and model weights remain in the customer network. Networking requires 2 outbound TLS endpoints from the gateway for telemetry and control-plane (or express peering if customer insists).
- Security: SOC2 artifacts we can share; if customer requires HSM-backed key storage we need an exception lane (we can integrate with customer KMS but HSM provisioning timeline may add 3–6 weeks).
- Staffing for 6-week pilot (minimal): 0.5 FTE infra eng (setup + handoff), 0.3 FTE SRE (oncall rotation coverage during pilot), 0.2 FTE solutions engineer (integration & runbooks). If we include an on-prem gateway install tech (customer site), tack on 0.2 FTE for travel/coordination.
- Blockers / exceptions: air-gapped environments (no outbound) require packaged on-prem install — not supported in 2-week lead; health-care PHI logging retention policy may require per-token redaction (product ask).

I'll draft a one-paragraph statement below you can paste to Procurement.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-25T14:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick feasibility check for Acme Health (private pilot)

Adding ops constraints and timeline realism —

- Infra tasks (high level): VPC routing rules review, customer peering setup (if used), gateway deployment + TLS certs, limited perf testing (p95 latency baseline), log forwarding validation. Expect 10–15 total engineering-days across tasks.
- Timeline: realistic minimal lead is 3 weeks from sign-off to pilot start if customer can do certs and basic networking in parallel. 6 weeks total pilot ok.
- Oncall: we need a dedicated oncall rotation for pilot hours (we can reuse existing Dedicated oncall with explicit SLAs). If they want 24/7 coverage we need an escalation plan with a 4-hour SLA — that is an extra support tier.
- Risks: If Acme insists on HSM at launch, add 3–6 weeks and possibly vendor procurement (customer-managed). If they require additional compliance artifacts (e.g., audit log extracts rather than audit logging forward) that is a product add.

I'll attach a short task list by EOD.

— Karthik
Sr. Manager, Platform Engineering

From: Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@acmehealth.com>

I've uploaded the SOC questions doc (acme-soc2-questions.pdf) — some items are mandatory for their security council review on Monday.

Tom Jensen

Acme Health

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@acmehealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-29T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick feasibility check for Acme Health (private pilot)

Tom / Procurement —

One-paragraph statement for your approval/hand-off to Purchasing: 

"Redwood Inference can support a 6-week private pilot inside Acme Health's VPC. The pilot will run our Private control plane with a customer-hosted gateway that keeps model serving traffic and KV cache inside Acme's network. Required customer deliverables at kickoff: 1) network routes allowing outbound TLS to two Redwood endpoints (control-plane and telemetry) or an approved peering arrangement; 2) TLS certificates for the gateway (customer CA or publicly trusted certs accepted; self-signed allowed for short pilots but not for production); 3) KMS access or keys to enable encrypted artifact storage (HSM optional and will extend timeline). Estimated Redwood effort: ~10–15 engineering days (split infra + SRE) plus ~2-4 days of SE support for integration runbooks. If HSM or airgap is required, timeline extends by 3–6 weeks and additional procurement will be needed."

Attachments shared: pilot-scope-delta.xlsx (customer asks) and acme-soc2-questions.pdf (security questionnaire). Please flag any additional must-have items; otherwise Procurement can proceed with SOW creation.

Next steps (internal): I will create a minimal task breakdown and staffing schedule for the pilot and drop it in the HubSpot deal record. If Sales wants an SLA exception (4-hr escalation), loop in Support for costing.

— Irene Choi
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: pilot-scope-delta.xlsx (XLSX)]
[Attachment: acme-soc2-questions.pdf (PDF)]
